parameters.name: AccessOrigin
parameters.description:
The source of the domain name. Valid values:

- **share**: The domain name is added to WAF in CNAME record mode.

- **asset**: The domain name is added to WAF as a custom asset.

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**: The domain name is added to WAF in hybrid cloud CNAME record mode.

- **tgw**: The domain name is added to WAF in cloud native mode.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name that you want to query for ownership verification content.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.
